entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Teiichi Fukuda , also known as Ryōtarō Shiba , was a Japanese author. He is best known for his novels about historical events in Japan and on the Northeast Asian sub-continent, as well as his historical and cultural essays pertaining to Japan and its relationship to the rest of the world.
